sourceReview: The official Lianjiang municipal portal publishes current notices sourced to 廉江市自然资源局, establishing the local planning/natural-resources custodian. Guangdong’s official public map viewer was inspected through its current HTML and JavaScript; it exposes public base-map tile configuration but no cadastral parcel feature route. The province’s official explanation identifies the 不动产登记/地籍图 visualization service and states that access proceeds through identity authentication. This is local registry/procedure evidence, not qualified parcel-source integration.
